name: Special Delivery for Gaxim
objectiveText: Bring the Scroll of Messaging to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon. Scroll of Messaging (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: To get this quest, you need to complete "Devils in Westfall" (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1076).

It looks like this quest can chain to another quest, https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1079/covert-ops-alpha. But I think you have to also complete https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1074/ineptitude-chemicals-fun.

is in the Mage Quarter 

Coords are 43,80

This quest is part of a chain of chain quests.

The first quest in the chain is On Guard in Ashenvale, which begins in Astraanar, though it may be possible to start the chain from Gaxim himself.

I'm probably not the first dwarf/gnome/human to miss this and all the Venture Co stuff because we have a full quest log and way too much to keep us busy in Westfall and Redridge. I hadn't even pushed through to Menethil Harbour let alone got through Ashenvale and into Stonetalon. This should stay an option from Mauren a lot longer than it does, by the time I got back to him he was offering the basilisk quest.
JUst a simple delivery to get back to Gaxim in Stonetalon. Was worth 825 exp.
sweet...but where is he, thats all i care about.
